claim: Mercurey is predominantly red and the best known of the four village appellations there.
because: The Cote Chalonnaise has five village appellations: Bouzeron, Rully, Mercurey, Givry and Montagny. Bouzeron has been a village AOC since the 1997/1998 change, and question i-fxjrv9gh in this same bank teaches it as one. The key (Mercurey, the largest) is correct.
fix: Mercurey is predominantly red and the largest and best known of the five village appellations there (Bouzeron, Rully, Mercurey, Givry, Montagny).
